ecological_question: Does independently surveyed island-level ubiquity of introduced arthropod taxa in disturbed/coastal ruderal habitats provide source-independent information about historical BALA native-forest beetle spatial homogenization across the six overlapping Azorean islands?

publication.dataset: The PRIBES Project: A survey of exotic arthropods in Azorean disturbed coastal ruderal habitats

published_design.method: 1 hour time-standardized vegetation beating in ruderal coastal/edge vegetation
published_design.species: 247 identified taxa, plus 119 morphospecies, per published article; only identified taxa have source-assigned colonization status

original_BALA_independent_response.dataset: BALA original 1997-2022 native-forest pitfall study, different survey/sampling sites

predeclared_cross_source_scope.physical_unit_in_new_source: independent survey site locationID, NOT 80 original Event records if repeated at site, not original individual specimens
predeclared_cross_source_scope.sample_method_mismatch: PRIBES plant beating vs BALA pitfall, so source-side beetles do not represent BALA ground beetle detection in matched sampling; compare only island-level environmental context with explicit caveat.
predeclared_cross_source_scope.primary_external_predictor: Mean within-island site-pair Jaccard similarity of IDENTIFIED INTRODUCED Coleoptera taxon detections in PRIBES ruderal sites, retaining only sites with at least one source-recognized introduced species; defined 0 when a nonempty pair shares none; pair count dependent; first require >=4 eligible independent sites per island and >=2 distinct identified introduced beetle taxa per island. An island failing predeclared support gives primary STOP, not a smaller handpicked positive subset.
predeclared_cross_source_scope.comparison: Spearman rank correlation of six source-side introduced beetle similarity scores against negative of fixed BALA spatial Simpson delta (larger is stronger forest homogenization), with exact 6!=720 island-label permutations and both positive/negative directions reported. Do not infer mechanism causally. No p-value if six-island support fails.
predeclared_cross_source_scope.negative_control: Source-side NATIVE+ENDEMIC Coleoptera site Jaccard similarity under same methods. If source native association is at least as strong as introduced, a specific exotic-source mechanism is not supported.
predeclared_cross_source_scope.secondary: PRIBES Araeneae introduced-source site similarity exploratory, do not use to rescue primary.
predeclared_cross_source_scope.source_origin_ontology: Require original Occurrence establishmentMeans contains explicitly introduced/endemic/native statuses. Restrict original taxonRank species/subspecies only; unresolved morphospecies and blank statuses never used for named source pool. No after-value relabel.

Only one source response execution, archive result and seal original runner. No repeated analysis after outcome or threshold retuning.
scientific_ceiling: This is a contemporaneous independently sampled disturbed-habitat exposure proxy, NOT observed arthropod transfer or movement into native forests.
N=6 original island contexts, not 79 independent forest change outcomes or six independent archipelagos.
Original BALA pitfall and PRIBES beating have fundamentally different taxonomic and detectability responses.
Anthropogenic disturbance, island area, forest cover, geography and urbanization remain confounders.
No assertion of forest invasive decline, actual colonization/extinction, metapopulation rescue, causal source–sink mechanism.
